sources.entry: Deskmark - Add watermarks to the desktop, ideal for recording videos. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/app/Deskmark/6755948110?platform=mac)

summary.name: Deskmark
summary.one_liner: Deskmark is a native macOS app that tiles text and icon watermarks across the desktop, intended for use while recording videos.
use_cases: Add a watermark to the desktop while recording videos
Tile text or image watermarks across the screen
Protect screenshots or screen captures with a visible mark
summary.what_it_does:
Deskmark is a native macOS app that adds text and icon watermarks to the desktop. Image and text watermarks can be tiled across the desktop. Users can customize the watermark angle, text size, icon, spacing, and text color. The app is aimed at keeping a watermark visible while recording videos. The page lists it as free with in-app purchases, and it is 2.7 MB in size.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">freemium
notable: Tiles text and icon watermarks across the entire desktop
Adjustable angle, text size, icon, spacing and color
Listed in awesome-mac under General Tools
Collects no data according to the developer's App Store privacy label
caveats: Offers in-app purchases (All Access Lifetime listed at $3.99)
